item.tib: drin chen bla ma'i sgrub pa las bskang bshags nyon mongs rang grol
item.coloph: ces skyabs gnas 'dus gtso mchog gsum drin can bla ma'i sgrub pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ bskang chung nyon mongs rang grol zhes bya ba 'di yang / bstan 'gro'i dpal yon du gyur pa'i spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang / ma zad lung rtogs bon gyi gnas lngas phyug pa'i rigs mthun gyi grogs po brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis rten 'brel legs mtshon spyi blug lha rdzas dar dkar gyis sna drangs nas bskul ba la brten/ bka' gsung gyen ldog ma nus nas/ rgod rje'i rus 'thob tshe dbang bde chen snying pos bon gyi 'dus sde chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang duspel ba 'dis kyang / sa lam nyams rtogs bskyed cing lta sgom yang rtser phyin pa'i rgyur ru gyur cig/
